text: A workshop produces {product_x1_name} and {product_x2_name}. Let x1 and x2 denote their respective production quantities. Both quantities may take any nonnegative real value. Each unit of {product_x1_name} earns a profit of {objective_x1} {objective_unit}, and each unit of {product_x2_name} earns {objective_x2} {objective_unit}. Producing one unit of {product_x1_name} requires {constraint_1_x1} {resource_1_unit} of {resource_1_name} and {constraint_2_x1} {resource_2_unit} of {resource_2_name}. Producing one unit of {product_x2_name} requires {constraint_1_x2} {resource_1_unit} of {resource_1_name} and {constraint_2_x2} {resource_2_unit} of {resource_2_name}. The workshop has at most {rhs_1} {resource_1_unit} of {resource_1_name} and {rhs_2} {resource_2_unit} of {resource_2_name} available. Determine the production quantities that maximize total profit.
